ideas.monetization: Freemium with basic budgeting features; premium subscription ($5.99/month) for advanced insights, investment tracking integration, and debt management tools.

ideas.name: Plant Health Diagnostician
ideas.problem: Amateur gardeners often struggle to identify and treat plant diseases and nutrient deficiencies, leading to plant loss. Users can upload photos of their ailing plants, and the app uses image recognition to diagnose issues and recommend tailored solutions and care routines.
ideas.monetization: Freemium with a limited number of diagnoses per month; a subscription ($4.99/month) offers unlimited diagnoses and access to a community forum.
